description: SET CONTENT OF { identifier-14 } … TO { FARTHEST-FROM-ZERO [IN-ARITHMETIC-RANGE] | FLOAT-INFINITY | FLOAT-NOT-A-NUMBER | FLOAT-NOT-A-NUMBER-SIGNALING | NEAREST-TO-ZERO [IN-ARITHMETIC-RANGE] } [SIGN {NEGATIVE|POSITIVE}] (ISO §2023:14.9.39.2 Format 15, numeric-content) — set a numeric item to an extreme its own description permits (GR32/GR36) or a standard floating-point item to an ISO/IEC 60559:2020 canonical infinity / quiet NaN / signaling NaN (GR33/GR34/GR35). MANDATORY base language: neither Annex A.3 nor Annex A.4 carries it (A.4's whole SET inventory is formats 6, 11/12 and 14). Recognition gate on setContentStatement — syntactically self-identifying, so it fires in the ParseArm. kb/Work PB452.
display: SET CONTENT OF n TO FARTHEST-FROM-ZERO
citation: ISO §2023:14.9.39.2 Format 15; §2023:14.9.39.3 SR31/SR32; §2023:14.9.39.4 GR32-GR36; Annex D.32. Edition: the five value words and IN-ARITHMETIC-RANGE are §2023:8.9-reserved from 2014, and Annex E records no SET-statement change into 2023 beyond E.3.3's dynamic-length item, so the format is a 2014 addition.
vcr: the introducing standard (ISO 2014) — VERSION_CHANGE_REFERENCE.md covers 2002→2023 deltas only

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. SETNUMCONT.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 N PIC S9(4)V99.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    SET CONTENT OF N TO FARTHEST-FROM-ZERO.
    DISPLAY N.
    STOP RUN.
